x: Ian Badiali won the Shipping A.A. 440 yards championship in 52.1 seconds, and Len Rolls won the Veterans A.C. 880 yards championship. Ted Smith won the London Transport 7 miles Walk Championship at Wembley in record time.
The Wandsworth Council promoted a 14 miles road run in connection with their Coronation celebrations, and Geoff Pearson finished 3rd, with Len Rolls 8th and Bert Smith 15th.
Bill Speaight, a veteran and second claim member was an easy winner of the handicap, with Len Rolls another vet. second and young Gowar, a lad who looks about 20 but is only 16, 3rd.

Second was August running in very promising style and 3rd Len Rolls. Three field events handicaps were carried through and despite reasonably good entries before the day, competition was limited on the evening itself to a few enthusiasts.
